---
format: docx
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
source("hooks.R")
## the hook takes over numbering: strips the fig- id so Quarto does not number/cross-reference the
## figure, and builds the caption itself: bookmark + "Figure " + live SEQ field + ": " + text.
.bm_id <- 900L
chain_hook("plot", after = function(res, options) {
  id <- options$label
  m <- regmatches(res, regexec("!\\[([^]]*)\\]\\(([^)]*)\\)(\\{[^}]*\\})?", res))[[1]]
  if (length(m) == 0) return(res)
  field <- function(instr) paste0("`<w:r><w:fldChar w:fldCharType=\"begin\" w:dirty=\"true\"/></w:r><w:r><w:instrText xml:space=\"preserve\"> ", instr, " </w:instrText></w:r><w:r><w:fldChar w:fldCharType=\"end\"/></w:r>`{=openxml}")
  .bm_id <<- .bm_id + 1L
  bm_s <- sprintf("`<w:bookmarkStart w:id=\"%d\" w:name=\"%s\"/>`{=openxml}", .bm_id, id)
  bm_e <- sprintf("`<w:bookmarkEnd w:id=\"%d\"/>`{=openxml}", .bm_id)
  cap <- paste0("Figure ", bm_s, field("SEQ Figure \\* Arabic"), bm_e, ": ", m[2])
  attrs <- gsub("#[A-Za-z0-9_-]+ *", "", m[4])           # keep width/align/alt, drop the fig- id
  if (!nzchar(gsub("[{} ]", "", attrs))) attrs <- ""
  sub(m[1], sprintf("![%s](%s)%s", cap, m[3], attrs), res, fixed = TRUE)
})
oq_ref <- function(id) knitr::asis_output(paste0("`<w:hyperlink w:anchor=\"", id, "\"><w:r><w:fldChar w:fldCharType=\"begin\" w:dirty=\"true\"/></w:r><w:r><w:instrText xml:space=\"preserve\"> REF ", id, " \\h </w:instrText></w:r><w:r><w:fldChar w:fldCharType=\"end\"/></w:r></w:hyperlink>`{=openxml}"))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-a
#| fig-cap: "CAP-A"
plot(1:3)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-b
#| fig-cap: "CAP-B"
plot(3:1)
```

See @fig-a and @fig-b.
